payload.reason: The evidence clearly indicates that the NER model incorporates both text and images for named entity recognition, demonstrating its multimodal capabilities.

claims.text: The NER model learns from both text and images by using a hybrid LSTM-CNN architecture that processes both modalities.
The model incorporates visual context to augment textual information, indicating it learns from both text and images.
The proposed multimodal NER task specifically combines image and text inputs for recognition, confirming the use of both modalities.
The model outperforms traditional text-only NER models by leveraging visual contexts, further supporting its multimodal learning approach.
